settings.heading: Captain's Quarters
settings.ai_enable_desc: Rewrites text based on yer orders.
settings.privacy_body_1: API keys be stowed locally in yer browser (localStorage) an' sent only to the AI provider's API — never to any middleman. Ye can scuttle 'em any time.
settings.privacy_body_2: This app stows six things in localStorage: yer ship's colors, yer tongue, yer vessel filter (Web/Native), yer live hunt setting, yer active AI provider, an' yer API keys. No other cargo be stowed or sent.
settings.privacy_body_translations: UI translations an' base corpus translations were drawn up by AI an' may contain errors. No custom or user-entered cargo is ever sent out for translation.
settings.reduced_motion_note: Ye've got reduced motion turned on, an' we respect that. Animations like confetti will walk the plank until ye change it in yer OS accessibility settings.
notfound.heading: 404 — Charted No Waters Here!
notfound.body: Ye've sailed off the map, matey. Let's chart a course back to port.
party.announce_full: Treasure mode activated, arrr! The font has changed to Comic Sans. The colors have changed to a blazin' bright palette. Colorful confetti be fallin' from the crow's nest in all manner of colors and shapes. The mouse cursor is now a cutlass.
party.announce_reduced: Treasure mode activated, arrr! The font has changed to Comic Sans. The colors have changed to a blazin' bright palette. The mouse cursor is now a cutlass. Confetti walked the plank because reduced motion be turned on.
kofi.aria: Support Mikey on Ko-fi (opens the hatch)
kofi.title: Ko-fi donation widget
about.what_heading: What manner o' ship be this?
about.what_body: A personal accessibility audit writin' first mate. Search a trove o' WCAG-aligned blight write-ups, pick one that matches yer findin', customize it, and copy it straight into yer audit log.
about.what_wcag: Coverage extends up to WCAG 2.2 (Level A and AA) across both web and native app contexts.
about.step_1_body: Scrawl what ye observed — a component name, element type, or plain-speak description.
about.step_2_body: Use the Priority Up/Priority Down arrows on each result to tune how results are ranked. Star to show first. Archive to hide it.
about.step_3_body: Add a ship's bearing prefix (arr, "Global:") and use the AI Sharpen field to tailor the wording.
about.step_4_body: Add a location prefix (e.g. "Global:") or use AI to help revise the wording.
about.feature_ai_body: Sharpen any blight description with a short order. Yer API key, yer AI provider — never stowed server-side.
about.feature_languages_body: The UI be available in over 50 tongues includin' RTL support. Switch in Captain's Quarters.
about.feature_party_body: Arr, it be in the Captain's Quarters. Under Ship's Colors. Ye'll know it when ye see it.
about.feature_a11y_body: Built to WCAG 2.2: focus management, live regions, keyboard navigation, reduced motion support, and high-contrast tokens.
about.coming_auth: Optional sign-in with Google or GitHub to sync yer settings across vessels.
about.coming_custom: Add and edit yer own custom blight entries, stowed privately in the cloud.
about.coming_ai: Additional AI providers: OpenAI, Google Gemini, and more, arrr.
settings.confirm_reset_all_body: This will walk all saved settings off the plank — including yer API keys — and return everything to port defaults. This cannot be undone, sailor.
settings.unsaved_body: You have unsaved changes to your AI settings. What would you like to do?
settings.language_changed_announce: Tongue: Course Altered, press ye Stow button to confirm, arr!
results.vote_hint: Vote results up or down — higher-rated matches appear first. Star a result to always pin it to the top.
announce.starred: {title} starred — will appear first in relevant results.
settings.voting_on: Vote controls are visible on each result.
about.step_5_body: Use the up/down arrows on each result to tune how results are ranked. Star a result to always pin it first. Archive entries you never want to see again.
